decisions.reason: Quantified use by a major public customer and connectivity with more than 30 government APIS schemes place this product clearly above aspiration, so we keep it.

Its fit with our travel-compliance portfolio and prior standalone positioning justify another year of support under current organisational slack, although the lack of visible adoption keeps it close to the aspiration threshold.
Because it uses our existing training capabilities and customer base with relatively low incremental commitment, we keep it despite still-limited public performance feedback.
After two years without strong market evidence, this more demanding and sensitive security technology appears to be underperforming aspiration, so we would reallocate resources.
The continued absence of visible traction in a reputationally sensitive profiling offering suggests persistent performance below aspiration, making withdrawal the prudent choice.
This platform remains closely aligned with our airport, border, and document-verification business, so its strategic fit supports retention even though results are not publicly quantified.
